text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While passing behind the school
building in the
evening, I spot an awfully
subdued Marvelous
Sunday.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Marvelous...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Hm? What brings you here, Marvelous?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I came to see the flowers in bloom, but
they've all
withered.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: And they were so beautiful...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Ahh, I see.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
But do you know what perennial plants
are,
Marvelous?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Um... Nope, never heard of that! Tell me
about
them, Ardan! ☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Even after their flowers are scattered to
the wind,
and their leaves and stems
have withered...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
The roots of perennial plants live on in
the soil.
And the following year, their
flowers bloom again.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Wooow! That's amazing!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. So I'm sure that this time next
year, there
will be many beautiful
flowers in bloom right here.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
You learn something new every day!
Perennial
plants are so very, very
marvelous! ☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Marvelous. Yes, indeed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I lock eyes with Marvelous Sunday,
who's back to
her sprightly self.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. ☆ Aren't perennial plants
marvelous? ★

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I appreciate the kind words.
choice_data_list: メジロアルダンは物知りだね
なんで宿根草は1度枯れるのかな？
choice_data_list_en: Mejiro Ardan sure knows a lot.
Why do perennials die back once, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I did some research into the topic after
growing
curious as to why they bloom
again after having
withered.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
The way they continue to bloom is truly
splendid.
It's as if they've a strong will
that keeps them
from giving up.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
It really seems that way! ☆ They're
incredibly
marvelous! ★ I hope I can be
like a perennial
plant too. ☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
How wonderful. I, too, hope to follow
their
example.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Right! ☆ Let's become marvelous
together! ★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: That's a good question! Why do they wither?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
In the same manner that some animals
hibernate,
these plants rest in the earth
during seasons
unsuitable for their
growth.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Maybe they're storing up their energy
while they
wait for the moment they can
shine most
brilliantly.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
They live to the fullest in the limited
time they
have in this world. I, too, wish
to live that way.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Me too, me too! ☆ Let's become
marvelous
together! ★

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yes, let's both do our best.
